notablePrerequisites:
Robaran Mercenaries does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two Goblins.
description:
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Krenko's ability by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Grimgrin's ability by sacrificing a Goblin, untapping Robaran Mercenaries and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
